Manifest.Name: 垃圾场拾荒地图 / Dumping Ground Map
Manifest.Author: Local
Manifest.Description: 前往垃圾场时先打开地图选一块地标，确认后进入该区域，之后拾荒不再询问，本次停留内连续沿用；离开垃圾场后重新选择。地图共 7 个区域：入口空地（材料/工具/日用）、拆解堆（材料/工具/模组）、生活废料带（日用/食品/医疗）、报废终端区（模组/电子件）、医疗废弃点（医疗）、废武器堆（近战/枪械/弹药）、配件箱（枪械配件/弹药）。每个区域有独立的物品权重表，差异在于捡到什么。所有掉落调节都在游戏的模组设置窗口里：垃圾出现率倍率（0–100%，默认 50%，是「该区基础垃圾率减半」的倍率而不是垃圾占比）、高档物资出现率（0–30%，默认 0%）两条滑条，以及区域专精度一条四档下拉（较少 25% / 中等 50% / 较多 75% / 全部 100%，默认较多）。区域专精度对七个区通用，决定这一趟捡到的东西里、除垃圾之外有多少是本区才有的特色物品；每个区各有一份自己的特色清单，所以同一档在不同区会捡到不同的东西。垃圾是单独一档，只受垃圾倍率影响。高档物资没有保底，只有出现率一条概率设置。高档池已剔除剧情物品与功能装置（给埃莉诺的慰问包裹、成分光谱仪），现为 7 件纯可回收物资。七张基础表的垃圾权重都按同一个目标反解：垃圾 100% 时每区单次价值都是 12.26（实测差 0.05%），默认档（垃圾 50%、专精较多）七区为 16.32–16.55，不再有某个区明显偏肥；报废终端区原先默认档 26.62 已压平。滑条数值直接显示在右侧；七区列表上方先有一行固定的原版参考（垃圾 100%、无专精，各区 12.26，不随当前设置变化），再用「原版 → 现在」列出当前设置下七区各自的结果、各区平均与三个预设；点击预设会同时把区域专精度下拉切到对应档位。拖动时实时刷新，松手或点「应用」才写盘。 / When travelling to the Dumping Ground, pick a landmark first and enter that area; later searches reuse it for the rest of the visit, and the choice resets when you leave. The map now has seven areas: Main Gate (materials/tools/household), Scrap Pile (materials/tools/modules), Refuse Lane (household/food/medical), Dead Terminals (modules/electronics), Medical Waste (medical), Weapon Dump (melee/guns/ammo) and Parts Crates (gun mods/ammo). Each area has its own weight table, so what you find differs by area. All loot tuning lives in the game's mod settings window: a junk chance multiplier (0-100%, default 50% - a multiplier that halves each area's base junk chance, not a junk share), a high-value chance slider (0-30%, default 0%) and a four-tier region specialty dropdown (Rare 25% / Medium 50% / High 75% / All 100%, default High). Region specialty applies to all seven areas and decides how much of the haul, junk aside, is something only found in this region; each area has its own list, so the same tier still yields different goods per region. Junk is a separate tier controlled only by the junk multiplier. High-value finds have no pity: a single chance setting controls them. Slider values are shown on the right. Above the seven rows a fixed vanilla reference line shows the untouched tables (100% junk, no specialty, 12.26 in every area) and never follows the current settings; then "vanilla -> now" lists each area's result at the current settings, the all-area average and three presets, and clicking a preset also moves the specialty dropdown to the matching tier. All seven base tables are reverse-solved to the same target, so at 100% junk each area is worth 12.26 (0.05% spread); at the default (50% junk, High specialty) the seven areas sit at 16.32-16.55 with no area standing out. Everything refreshes while dragging; the config is written on release or when Apply is pressed.
